noah: Day 2 check-in — what I did: imaged MacBook, installed devkit, completed hello-runtime lab.
Blockers: corporate YubiKey not provisioned yet so can't access HSM; getting 403 on GCP (`gcloud projects list`); kube context not set (no kubeconfig).
Also blocked on PR review infra#412 — @carol can you take a look? Today: finish local runtime dev, sort token, push PR fixes. TL;DR: need help with hardware token + GCP IAM.

carol: Thanks Noah — I'll escalate the token to security. Meanwhile you can use Google Authenticator as a temporary MFA: https://intra.redwood/security/onboard-mfa. Open a ticket with infra and tag me.
For GCP try: `gcloud auth login` then `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-dev --format=json` — I can grant viewer once infra confirms.

infra-bot: Ticket #INC-2991 created for hardware token provisioning, assigned to infra-team. ETA ~2 business days. (If urgent, reply with `!priority`.)

tess: For kubectl, try:
```
export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config:~/.kube/dev-config
kubectl config use-context dev-cluster
```
If you don't have a kubeconfig, ping @sana for a temp one.

sana: I uploaded a stub kubeconfig to the onboarding bucket: gs://redwood-onboard/kubeconfigs/noah-dev.yml. `gsutil cp gs://redwood-onboard/kubeconfigs/noah-dev.yml ~/.kube/dev-config` then export as above. Also if apt fails run `sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential` :thumbsup:

carol: I just added you to gcp-projects/redwood-dev/viewer — should be immediate, give it ~5 mins then `gcloud auth login` and `gcloud projects list`. @noah ping if still 403.

noah: Got the kubeconfig, can see pods now. Still waiting on YubiKey ticket but can continue local dev. Will address lint comments and re-request review on infra#412. ETA EOD. :rocket:
